title: Wire Insights UI to backend-driven metrics and ensure post-ritual refresh

requirements.summary: Update Insights screen to consume backend-driven Insights + milestone values and refresh automatically after ritual submission (no redesign).
acceptanceCriteria: After completing a ritual from both accounts, the Insights page shows non-zero streak and a 7-day history row for Today marked Done (not Missed) once polling/refetch completes.
Milestone badges reflect backend milestone booleans (unlock when backend says unlocked).
No changes are made to immutable frontend paths listed in SYSTEM_CONTEXT.

file_operations.description: Align displayed Insights metrics with backend-provided values: use getInsightsData().quizOverlapScore (and related harmony metrics already returned) as the source of truth for quiz alignment/harmony sections; avoid showing misleading 0% placeholders by adding a lightweight loading/empty-state behavior while insights data is still fetching; keep milestone badge unlocked state driven by getBadgeMilestones().milestones booleans and preserve existing UI layout.

Ensure post-ritual submission refresh remains robust: confirm submitRitualResponse success flow invalidates and refetches insightsData and badgeMilestones (and related ritual queries) so Insights updates without hard reload; adjust query options only if needed to reliably reflect new backend values (e.g., staleTime/refetch timing) while keeping polling behavior.
